reuse.why: Adds the rule inside the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories selector that every month-wide action already uses, and parses notes with the existing shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the tag check exists once in the shared selector.

placement.why: The exclusion rule sits next to the other exclusion rules in the month-wide selection helper in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the selector, its comment and the relevant tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised, though the rule is split between SQL filters and a post-query JS filter with a hard-coded 'fixed' literal.

one_place.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action
